verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing describes connecting cross-team initiatives (jira-docs-8), tracking progress toward top priorities (jira-docs-14), prioritizing work and cultivating ownership (jira-docs-23), keeping status current (jira-docs-4), and customizable fields and workflows (jira-docs-3). However, none of this explicitly documents an initiative-level item that carries status, priority, and an owning-team field together; it is high-level feature copy with no corroboration. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an initiative hierarchy level, a documented owning-team field on initiatives, priority fields specific to initiatives, independent or hands-on corroboration.
